_comment: Which leg of the lethal trifecta each tool supplies. 'reads' = what a model sees if it reads the result; 'exit' = the call itself can carry data out or act.

search_emails.why: inbox content is private, and anyone can write an email body

search_files.why: drive files are private; shared files can be edited by outsiders

get_contact.why: the staff directory is internal; IT maintains it, so it is trusted

send_email.why: sends any text to any address

share_file.why: gives any address read access to a file

fetch_url.why: the URL itself carries data out; the page that comes back is untrusted
